items.title: half-point-baseline
items.claim: In Image #8, the denominator of the result’s '2½' drops onto a separate line below '0 — 2', and the HUD fraction also extends below its adjacent whole number.
items.reason: The total looks like disconnected numbers rather than one score.
items.suggest: Render each score as a non-wrapping inline group with a compact fraction vertically centered beside the whole number.

items.title: impact-contact-offset
items.claim: In Image #12, bright impact streaks appear around Asmongold’s belt while HasanAbi’s extended foot meets his shoulder or neck, roughly 50 CSS pixels higher.
items.reason: The effect and attacking foot disagree about where contact occurs.
items.suggest: Anchor the concentrated impact burst to the attacking limb’s visible contact point instead of the defender’s torso center.

items.title: indistinct-kicking-foot
items.claim: In Image #13, I cannot distinguish a foot beyond the raised trouser cuff, although the supporting foot is clearly visible.
items.reason: The kick’s striking endpoint and reach are difficult to read.
items.suggest: Revise that kick pose so the ankle and foot have a complete, clearly separated silhouette, preserving its existing ground anchor.

items.title: undersized-fighter-names
items.claim: In Image #3, the HUD fighter names have approximately 10 CSS pixels of visible capital-letter height at the stated 390-pixel viewport width.
items.reason: Players must read tiny, widely spaced lettering to associate each score with its fighter.
items.suggest: Use at least 18px computed text for fighter names, reduce letter spacing, and place each name above its score if necessary.

items.title: desktop-bindings-not-shown
items.claim: Image #9 shows pads labeled 'STANCE' and 'TECHNIQUE' but no visible keyboard bindings for either control.
items.reason: A desktop player cannot determine the keyboard controls from this screen.
items.suggest: Display the actual mapped keyboard keys beside each pad’s directions on desktop, while retaining the touch layout on phones.
